name: Chrome HW Accel
author: Whit Milan <whitmilan00@gmail.com>
description: Bar toggle for Chrome/Chromium hardware acceleration -- flips the setting and restarts the browser with tabs restored. Useful when GPU acceleration causes freezing/jitter on video playback.

barWidget.description: Shows whether Chrome/Chromium hardware acceleration is on or off. Click to open, then confirm to toggle and restart the browser with tabs restored.
